title: DollarBattleGround.com Feedback requested
author: Remote-Ad-510
selftext:
Hi everyone I just recently launch a territory style game that has a social experiment on the back end.

  
Basically do you want to keep your territory or let it go.

  
I have two feedback questions.  
1) One element I want to add is a strategic reason for choosing where you place.

2) How do i get more people to try it out. (It is free to play)

I have some TikTok and things going with over 10,000 views but very few peopel who have actually gone in a placed a tile.

Any help would be awesome!

[https://dollarbattleground.com/](https://dollarbattleground.com/)
